tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be individual Proprietorship Firm or Partnership Firm or Company Registered under Companies Act/ Partnership Act.Registration certificate /SSI Certificate / License issued by the Commerce & Industries Department or any other Government statutory Authority.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be a Manufacturer or Authorized Dealer for supply of TRIVECTOR METER.A.In case of Manufacturer: Manufacturing License B.In case of Authorized Dealer: i.Authorization letter from the OEM assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as perGCC.Manufacturing license of Original Equipment Manufacturer.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The meter manufacturer should have a minimum of 5 years of experience in supply of TRIVECTOR METER. In case the bidder is a dealer all relevant documents required to meet the tender requirement shall be submitted from the meter manufacturer.Purchase Order/ Order Completion Certificates in respect of experience of minimum 5 years in supply of TRIVECTOR METER.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The CT ratios required for the meters must be calibrated as per MEI requirement as and when needed.Confirmation letters from the respective OEM shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should furnish order completion certificate for having supplied not less than 80 % of the tendered quantity (However it will be 40 % to Micro and Small Enterprises) of TRIVECTOR METER in any one of the last 3 years (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) from any Government Electrical Utilities/PSUs.1)Purchase Order copies placed by any Government Electrical Utilities/factories/private organization shall be uploaded.2)The bidder/manufacturer shall submit the performance certificate for TVM with SMASTA feature Meter mentioning the PO details for a period of 18 months issued by officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer/DGM or equivalent officer of the concerned Government electrical utilities for 100% of the tendered qty. In case the bidder is a dealer certificate from the manufacturer issued by any utility shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall furnish test certificates for type test conducted as per IS/IEC standards at CPRI/ERDA/NABL Accredited Govt laboratories/NABL Accredited Govt Testing Houses to ascertain the quality of TRIVECTOR METER. The Type Test Reports shall not be older than 5 Years from the date of bid opening.Type Test certificates shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Average Annual Financial Turnover of the Tenderer should be not less than the amount put to tender (However it will be 50% with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises) during the last 3 preceding financial years (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25)Certified copies of audited financial statements such as P&L statement, Balance sheets for the FY (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) shall be uploaded WITH UDIN.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded
